{{Current events|year=2020|month=03|day=20|content=
<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Business and economy
*[[Socio-economic impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Japan]], [[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
***[[Japan]]ese car manufacturer [[Nissan]] suspends production indefinitely at its major [[Nissan Motor Manufacturing UK]] plant in [[Sunderland]], [[Tyne and Wear]], over the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]]. [https://www.chroniclelive.co.uk/news/north-east-news/nissan-suspends-production-sunderland-indefinitely-17954358 (''Evening Chronicle'')]
***The [[Government of the United Kingdom|British government]] announces a stimulus plan to counter the socioeconomic impacts of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]], which includes the government paying a portion of citizens' wages. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-03-20/u-k-government-to-help-pay-workers-wages-during-pandemic (Bloomberg News)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
***The [[United States]] moves [[Tax Day]] from April 15 to July 15 due to the spread of the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/20/politics/steven-mnuchin-tax-day-july-15/index.html (CNN)]
***[[United Airlines]] announces it will cancel 95 percent of its international flights starting next month. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/travel/airline-news/2020/03/21/coronavirus-united-airlines-cuts-95-percent-international-flights/2891481001/ (''USA Today'')]

;Health and environment
*[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic]]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in South America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Argentina]]
****[[Argentina]] begins a mandatory national [[quarantine]] until March 31, restricting people to their homes to prevent the spread of the [[Coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. People will only be allowed to leave their homes to shop for basic goods, like food and medicine, according to [[President of Argentina|President]] [[Alberto Fernández]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-argentina/argentina-announces-mandatory-quarantine-to-curb-coronavirus-idUSKBN216446 (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Paraguay]]
****The first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] is reported in [[Paraguay]], a 69-year-old man who had been hospitalized in intensive care, while the total of those infected rises to 18. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/20/world/americas/20reuters-health-coronavirus-paraguay.html (''The New York Times'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Europe]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Spain]]
****The death toll from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in [[Spain]] exceeds 1,000 while the total number of those infected reaches 20,000. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-spain-tally/spains-coronavirus-death-toll-surpasses-1000-idUSKBN2171IA (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[NHS England]] increases the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll to 184. The patients who died were aged between 50 and 99 and had underlying health conditions. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-39-more-die-in-england-countrys-total-now-167-11960796 (Sky News)] [https://www.itv.com/news/2020-03-20/coronavirus-death-count-cases-rise-england/(''ITV News'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] declares a 'state of epidemic' amid the coronavirus pandemic, Prime Minister [[Mateusz Morawiecki]] announces at a press conference late on Friday. Two-week suspension of schools, introduced earlier this month, would be extended until after the Easter holidays. The government announces that fines for anyone breaking coronavirus quarantine increase from the current [[Polish złoty|PLN]] 5,000 up to PLN 30,000 (EUR 6,600, USD 7,050). [https://www.polskieradio.pl/395/7789/Artykul/2477811,UPDATE-Poland-declares-%E2%80%98state-of-epidemic%E2%80%99-as-coronavirus-spreads (''Radio Poland'')] [https://www.politico.eu/article/poland-declares-coronavirus-epidemic/ (''Politico'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[Papua New Guinea]] reports its first confirmed case of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a male patient from [[Spain]] currently being isolated in [[Lae]]. The country will also close its borders. [https://news.pngfacts.com/2020/03/png-confirms-first-case-of-coronavirus.html (Papua New Guinea Today)] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/412291/png-to-close-borders-after-confirmation-of-first-covid-19-case (Radio New Zealand)]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Asia]]
***[[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in Hubei]], [[2019–20 coronavirus pandemic in mainland China]]
****[[China]] reports zero domestic cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] for a second consecutive day. [https://thehill.com/policy/international/china/488594-china-reports-no-new-coronavirus-cases-for-second-day-in-a-row (''The Hill'')]
****The [[World Health Organization]] says [[China]] reporting zero domestic cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] for two days in a row should "give the world hope." [https://www.sbs.com.au/news/world-health-organization-says-wuhan-s-recovery-provides-hope-for-rest-of-world (SBS World News)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Sri Lanka]]
****The [[Sri Lanka|Sri Lankan]] government imposes a nationwide [[curfew]] to contain [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. Mosques across the nation are closed. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-southasia/sri-lanka-imposes-curfew-as-south-asia-steps-up-coronavirus-battle-idUSKBN217117 (Reuters)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Israel]]
****[[Israel]] reports its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], an 88-year-old [[Holocaust survivor]] with [[pre-existing condition|pre-existing health conditions]]. [https://m.jpost.com/Breaking-News/First-coronavirus-death-in-Israel-621727 (''The Jerusalem Post'')] [https://www.timesofisrael.com/israels-first-virus-fatality-holocaust-survivor-aryeh-even-laid-to-rest/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]]'s [[Ministry of Health and Medical Education]] says the country's [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] death toll stands at 1,433, and confirms 1,237 new cases, bringing the total number of cases to 19,644 and 1,433 deaths. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/health/iran-death-toll-from-coronavirus-climbs-to-1-433/1773050 (Anadolu Agency)]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the Philippines]]
****Disinfection begins in [[La Trinidad, Benguet|La Trinidad]], the capital of the [[Philippines]] province [[Benguet]], in an effort to contain the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://www.sunstar.com.ph/article/1849360 (''Sun.Star'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]]
****The [[United Arab Emirates]] announces its first two deaths from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/reuters/2020/03/20/world/middleeast/20reuters-health-coronavirus-emirates-tally.html (''The New York Times'')]
****[[Dubai Municipality]] begins an 11-day sterilization campaign in an effort to contain the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus]]. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/health/watch-dubai-starts-massive-coronavirus-sterilisation-drive-1.70524415 (''Gulf News'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in North America]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Cuba]]
****In an effort to further prevent the spread of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], [[Cuba]] announces a ban on tourism and most air travel, starting Tuesday. This restriction does not apply to citizens and residents. [https://www.miamiherald.com/news/nation-world/world/americas/cuba/article241387431.html?utm_source=pushly&intcid=pushly_497628 (''Miami Herald'')]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in the United States]]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Illinois]]
*****[[Illinois]] [[Governor of Illinois|Governor]] [[J. B. Pritzker]] issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Illinoisans except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services. [https://www.nbcchicago.com/news/local/illinois-governor-expected-to-issue-stay-at-home-order-sources/2241118/ (WMAQ-TV)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York (state)|2020 coronavirus pandemic in New York]]
*****[[New York]] [[Governor of New York|Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all New Yorkers except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/20/politics/new-york-workforce-stay-home/index.html (CNN)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Connecticut]]
*****[[Connecticut]] [[List of governors of Connecticut|Governor]] [[Ned Lamont]] issues a statewide stay-at-home order for all Connecticuters except for essential errands such as grocery shopping or for medical services. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/US/2020/03/20/Connecticut-Illinois-New-York-issue-stay-at-home-orders/8111584722766/ (United Press International)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Michigan]]
*****A fourth death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] is reported in [[Michigan]], a man in his 50s with underlying health conditions in [[Oakland County, Michigan|Oakland County]]. [https://www.mlive.com/public-interest/2020/03/fourth-michigan-death-reported-due-to-coronavirus.html (MLive)]
****[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Arizona]]
*****[[Arizona]] records its first death from [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], a [[Maricopa County, Arizona|Maricopa County]]  man in his 50s with underlying health conditions. [https://www.12news.com/article/news/health/coronavirus/1st-coronavirus-death-in-az/75-dbf11b40-4a5e-4632-ba6c-6db5c230f23a (KPNX)]
****The [[Presidency of Donald Trump|Donald Trump administration]] announces it will limit nonessential travel between the [[United States]] and [[Mexico]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/03/20/politics/us-mexico-border/index.html?utm_term=1584722522390e88e84c87df2&utm_source=Breaking+News&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=155001&bt_ee=ZrAQSZutlMsWKW4YZaNmDKzAejXAwhFidM04AGa%2FV973guEAFsExPMXMTNWkEGCE&bt_ts=1584722522394 (CNN)]
****''[[The Washington Post]]'' reports that [[United States|U.S.]] [[United States Intelligence Community|intelligence agencies]] repeatedly warned [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump|Trump]] about the threats posed by [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] in January and February, but [[Presidency of Donald Trump|administration]] officials say they "just couldn't get him to do anything about it." [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/us-intelligence-reports-from-january-and-february-warned-about-a-likely-pandemic/2020/03/20/299d8cda-6ad5-11ea-b5f1-a5a804158597_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
**[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Africa]]
***[[2020 coronavirus pandemic in Madagascar]]
****[[Madagascar]] confirms its first cases of [[coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://nationalpost.com/pmn/health-pmn/madagascar-confirms-first-cases-of-coronavirus-president (''National Post'')]

;Law and crime
*[[Capital punishment in India]]
**[[India]] [[capital punishment in India|executes]] four men convicted of the [[2012 Delhi gang rape]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-rape-execution-timeline/timeline-india-executes-four-men-convicted-in-2012-delhi-gang-rape-murder-case-idUSKBN21700L (Reuters)]
*[[Cannabis in Ghana]]
**The parliament of [[Ghana]] votes to legalize the medical and industrial use of [[Cannabis (drug)|cannabis]]. [https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/Ghana-legalizes-cannabis-for-health-and-industrial-purposes-900280 (''GhanaWeb'')]

;Sports
*[[Impact of the 2019–20 coronavirus pandemic on sports]]
**[[2020 Summer Olympics]]
***[[International Olympic Committee]] President [[Thomas Bach]] says that canceling the [[2020 Summer Olympics]] due to the [[coronavirus disease 2019|coronavirus pandemic]] "is not on the agenda," but says it is too early to make a decision. [https://www.nytimes.com/2020/03/19/sports/olympics/olympics-coronavirus-bach-ioc.html (''The New York Times'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
